name: pantomimes-paradox
description: One reusable, versioned workflow for building software with an AI coding assistant: discovery, planning, delivery, independent review, evidence and closeout, with every response ending in the next step.

interface.shortDescription: One reusable workflow, shaped to each project.
interface.longDescription: Twelve skills with immutable, project-pinned process releases: start or adopt a project, get the next prompts, plan, resume, deliver, review, check evidence, trace a flow, close out.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set me up with The Pantomime's Paradox for this project.
